items.title_zh: Marilyn Monroe"看起来像"聚集 庆祝她100岁生日
items.summary: Ahead of what would have been Marilyn Monroe's 100th birthday, diehard fans dressed up in her iconic look - a white dress and platinum blonde wig - to celebrate the beloved American actress and model.
items.summary_zh: 在Marilyn Monroe100岁生日之前, 德哈德的粉丝们穿着她标志性的外观 -- -- 白色的裙子和白金金发 -- -- 来庆祝所爱的美国女演员和模特儿.

items.title: Between celebration and confrontation: Paris after PSG victory
items.title_zh: 在庆祝和对抗之间:PSG胜利后巴黎
items.summary: The BBC's Paris correspondent, James Waterhouse, described the French capital as "jubilant" on Sunday as he reported from the Champ de Mars where fans greeted the Paris St-Germain (PSG) players after their Champions League win.
items.summary_zh: BBC的巴黎通讯员詹姆斯·沃特豪斯(James Waterhouse)星期天将法国首都描述为"Jubilant",他从"Champ de Mars"中报道,球迷在他们的冠军联盟取胜后向巴黎圣日耳曼(PSG)球员致意.
